runtime.name: Replit Linux / Node / npm / Nix
runtime.acceptance: Configured supported runtimes install, build and start the exact prepared application on the verified Replit target.

runtime.name: Neon PostgreSQL
runtime.acceptance: Actual required schema, compatible writers, private connectivity and consistent recovery pass.

runtime.name: Imported local MaxCore + PDIM
runtime.acceptance: Private local children, scoped tokens, current capabilities, durable state and bounded supervision/recovery pass.

runtime.name: CPU Python / ffmpeg / media/native libraries
runtime.acceptance: Portable current-source runtime/artifact restore, actual media decode and native dependency loading pass.

runtime.name: Provider configuration
runtime.acceptance: Existing configured keys are used without disclosure; actual enabled callback/delivery/replay/recovery journeys pass on the verified origin.

runtime.name: Desktop / mobile / native VST
runtime.acceptance: Original source, supported native builders/resources, safe configuration and target-device journeys pass.

limits: Manifest declarations are exact static dependencies, not proof every installed consumer executes.
Per-page imported files and API candidates are retained separately; dynamic bindings and unresolved mappings require execution, not guesses.
No secrets or runtime environment values are read or written by this audit.
